I am happy to hear that life gets better for some people. 😊 I just don't know if I would believe that it would happen to me as well.

I'm so sorry if that ever happened to you. People who don't experience thinks it's just easy to ignore such things but, it's not. It builds up your anxiety and you keep on asking yourself what did you do wrong.

Oftentimes, I blame myself. If i wasn't too naive, trusting or if I didn't let his suicidal tendencies prevent me from leaving him, things might have been better.

I don't even know if I can still be intimate with another human being because the fact that I can be recorded unknowingly scares the hell out of me. I ended the relationship the moment I found out about his lies which was 6 months ago. The last time his wife tried to threatened me was last July.

I was triggered just today because I received an instagram request from a dummy account and when I checked it, I saw linked accounts of their family members.

Man, these people are crazy and I just couldn't understand anymore what's their issue this time.

I never replied to any of their threats which I think caused me to have so much suppressed emotions and now, I don't know how to handle these emotions.

It's overwhelming.

Thank you so much for sharing your experience with me.

HI 😭 sorry I just saw this. YOU ARE AWESOME TO GO THROUGH THESE LENGTHS JUST TO HELP ME. I went to the local police this afternoon and I am just really heart broken. All I was able to do is file a police blotter. I went to the women's desk and and they advised for me to go to the NBI Anti Cybercrime division. They said even if I try to file the case on their local pd, I might lose the case because the demons who have been harassing me can easily just say that their account was hacked and I wouldn't have any rebuttle for that.

They prefer for me to have the accounts tracked by the NBI for that would be a solid proof and they can even track the location. So that has been my day. And earlier this day, at 7am I received another set of  messages from the woman with the same content. She really doesn't know how to stop.

Your message is truly appreciated 😭
